name: nurl
description: Syntax highlighting + Language Server for NURL (Neural Unified Representation Language)

nurl.server.path.description: Absolute path to the nurl-lsp binary. Empty string falls back to <workspace>/build/nurl-lsp, then a PATH lookup for 'nurl-lsp'.

nurl.compiler.path.description: Absolute path to nurlc. Empty uses NURLC, the server's sibling binary, then PATH. Restart the language server after changes.

nurl.formatter.path.description: Absolute path to nurlfmt. Empty uses NURLFMT, the server's sibling binary, then PATH. Restart the language server after changes.

nurl.stdlibRoot.description: Toolchain directory containing stdlib/. Empty preserves NURL_STDLIB or discovers it beside the compiler installation. Restart the language server after changes.

nurl.server.trace.description: Trace LSP messages exchanged with the server (Output → 'NURL Language Server').
